notes: The pet's mood is fairer and follows the day: in the morning it compares your cards left with a typical day's (not every button press); by evening it checks whether the Today screen's minutes left fit before 11 pm, so a short pile late is "behind" and a long one "drowning"; Weather on networks that hide where they are (public, corporate): hako uses your time zone's city, and tries again in 15 minutes instead of 6 hours; The focus timer's ring sits in the top-left corner; Updates always show the progress ring (the bar is retired); The corner dot stays green through one slow answer from Anki and only blinks yellow after two missed checks; the settings page explains what each color means and shows Anki's last error
